# Local speech transcription and editable captions

The browser worker retains ScenePilot's real Whisper ASR algorithm: mono16kHz PCM, automatic-speech-recognition pipeline, actual word timestamps,30second chunks and5second stride. Source inspected at `tcc-operations/repos/scenepilot-studio-badass` revision `277f1544f7ac1e6e24426571c171cc21d3ea31ea`. Native caption grouping and SRT serialization are bundled from its `caption-words.ts` / `captions.ts`; no invented timestamps are used. Grouped cues retain first/last model word times. Raw text/word results always remain in the editable `.captions.json` document. Invalid/out-of-duration model timestamps are explicitly omitted from subtitles with a warning; users can add a cue with reviewed times.

Model is [Xenova/whisper-tiny.en](https://huggingface.co/Xenova/whisper-tiny.en/tree/79fb389fc764e7c395bd330e9531d9d32ada7049), pinned revision `79fb389fc764e7c395bd330e9531d9d32ada7049`. Its model card declares Apache-2.0 for the ONNX conversion; the original OpenAI Whisper model/code is MIT licensed. Both license texts and the unchanged card are retained. Installed Transformers.js4.3.0 is Apache-2.0. Its browser bundle is rebuilt with the WASM-only ONNX backend; ONNX Runtime1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0 is MIT. Runtime module/WASM reuse the pinned cutout assets. `scripts/vendor-transcription.mjs` performs explicit local rebuild only; builds never download models.

Two optional q8 weights total40,852,295bytes. They are intentionally absent from Git/public bundles. `transcription-model.js` pins each exact byte size/SHA256. Deliberate two-file installation uses `HoleModelStore` cache `hole-models-v1`, separately from Core/workspace backups. Every worker read verifies bytes/hash again. Config/tokenizer JSON is bundled, pinned and verified before use. Remote model loading is disabled; env.fetch admits only fixed local config paths and cache model reads. No network model fallback or private-audio upload is possible through this adapter. The shared cache can be removed independently; missing models produce an explicit installation error.

`HoleTranscription.run(blob,{signal,onProgress,timeoutMs})` accepts audio≤20MiB with known metadata duration≤60seconds, rejects decoded duration>60, resamples locally to16kHz mono, and starts one dedicated Worker. The entire job has a maximum180second deadline; abort/deadline terminates a running worker. Audio decoding happens in browser audio APIs before the worker and cannot be synchronously interrupted; metadata admission limits ordinary oversized inputs, but this is not a hard browser-process memory guarantee. The worker enforces PCM length/finite samples. English-only tiny.en is a bounded transcription option, not an accuracy guarantee for accents/noise/music or multilingual audio. Review the result.

`HoleTranscriptionCues` creates/validates native documents, edits/adds/deletes reviewed cues, and emits original-transcript TXT, reviewed SRT/VTT, and nativeJSON. Its mounted editor serializes asynchronous recovery callbacks, preserves visible edits on storage failure, exposes `flush()` and rejects close until recovery finishes. Save disables editing until its durable callback resolves. Root supplies scoped native resource commits and source audio; Actions supplies immutable input/model lineage and checks cancellation before atomic outputs.

Worker response CSP: `default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; connect-src 'self'`. Host also permits self workers and local blob media. No unsafe-eval, remote host wildcard, paid service or native execution is used by inference.

## Reproduce local qualification

1. Run `node scripts/provision-transcription-models.mjs /tmp/hole-transcription-models` explicitly (40.9MB download,150MiB cap,disk preflight,SHA verified).
2. Run `node scripts/create-transcription-fixture.mjs /tmp/hole-transcription-models` on macOS. It uses offline `say` with Samantha, converts to16kHz mono WAV and appends1.5seconds of silence for endpoint timing. The exact clearly synthetic sentence is retained in that script; no speech is supplied externally.
3. Run `node scripts/verify-transcription-browser.mjs` and the actual served shell qualifier `node scripts/verify-transcription-shell-browser.mjs`. `WHISPER_MODEL_DIR` selects the explicit QA files; `HOLE_URL` selects a built shell. The spoken fixture is not shipped as user content. Tests check recognizable real text, model times, outputs, source identity, editable recovery, worker cancellation and self-only requests. They do not establish broad ASR accuracy.
